part: Market page composition — MarketIntelLedger (real page component, not the ListSurfaceShell primitive)
source: dc.html p4 (#p4): masthead, band tiles, HEADLINE SERIES card, 'N signals · grouped by band · Show as one list' + Sort row, rail (Filters card, then Legend/sources-tracked), band-sectioned rows. This spec exists per the operator's own complaint ('the filters were not above the regulations, they were on the right — same on every page; you are NOT matching the images directly') and closes the DEVIATION-LOG's own logged gap (2026-09-06 row 97, partially closed 2026-09-08): the Headline Series card now nests inside the content column between the band tiles and the Sort row, not as its own full-bleed page section.
notes: Fixture matches capture-compose-lists-screenshots.mjs's own MARKET_ROWS/SERIES_BOARD (20 signal rows, 4 populated headline series with real Δ1w/Δ1m percentages) — the same shape the evidence screenshot renders, so the audit and the screenshot measure the identical mount.
The Headline Series card is asserted to mount BEFORE the sort row (DOM order), matching p4's own top-to-bottom order: band tiles, Headline Series, Sort row, band-sectioned rows.

Market has only 3 Sort options (Next date/Newest/A-Z, no 'My order') — the pre-existing DEVIATION-LOG row for the sort row already covers this; not re-asserted here to avoid duplicating that spec's own coverage.

Artboard 04's rail is FOUR cards top to bottom: Filters, CARBON COST PER FEU, NEXT DATA DROPS, Legend. The build carried SOURCES TRACKED where the two middle cards belong; lane lists60 (2026-09-08) built both from data the page already loads (the per-corridor carbonCostPerFeu() results page.tsx computes for the CarbonCostOverlay section, and the market_series board buildSeriesBoard() returns) and moved SOURCES TRACKED, an app feature no artboard draws, to after Legend, the last designed card of the column, per ruling R7.

UI FIX ROUND 2026-09-08, items A1/A3 (lane cardrule): the rows named 'A1 rule on ...' and 'A3 shell of ...' below measure the card shell the operator ruled belongs to the CARD component. They assert the gradient's exact value, which the earlier rule rows on this page did not; the closing 'CLASS CLOSURE' row is the check that fails if any card on this page renders with no rule at all.

LANE MARKET63 (2026-09-08), HEADLINE SERIES was rebuilt off `id="p4"` itself, opened in chromium and measured region by region, after the operator's instruction 'match the artboard, not the prose'. Two places where the brief's WORDS and the artboard's MARKUP disagree, both resolved to the artboard and recorded here so the divergence stays visible: the brief estimates each headline card at '~105px wide' where p4's own `repeat(5,1fr)` inside a 744px content box measures 140.797px; and the brief writes the value type as 'Anton 18px' where p4 measures 17px. The artboard wins in both, and both are what this spec now asserts.

THE ONE PLACE THIS PAGE DOES NOT FOLLOW p4. p4's HEADLINE SERIES head carries `border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08)` under the title. Operator ruling 5.1 (2026-09-07, CLOSED) says in as many words that there is NO divider below a section title, and a standing ruling outranks the image it was written against. No divider is rendered. The artboard's value is recorded here, per this harness's own README convention.

TRACK ARITHMETIC. The headline row's track is authored as `calc((100% - 40px) / 5)`, five columns and four 10px gutters, p4's own grid, expressed as a formula so it holds at any content width. This MOUNT has no nav card (it is the page component, not the AppShell frame), so its content column is 998px and the formula resolves to 191.594px per card; in the real /market frame the same formula resolves to p4's measured 140.797px. Proved by attack this lane: forcing the card to the artboard's own 778px outer width re-resolved every track to 141.188px against a 746px content box, which is `(746-40)/5`. The px value asserted below is therefore the mount's, and the artboard relationship is this note.

THE FIXTURE NOW CONTAINS THE ROW STATES THE ARTBOARD DRAWS (mounts.mjs, this lane). It previously scored NO row and dated EVERY row, so every assertion about the impact meter or about a dateless row passed vacuously, CLAUDE.md rule 15's exact failure. It now carries fully scored rows (the artboard's four-bar meter), one row scored on a single dimension (index 7, the operator's 'one bar and 2/12' case), unscored rows (which mobile-04-market-list.json measures as the 30px dashed baseline and which must stay), and one row with no compliance deadline and no timeline (index 8, in AWARENESS so the next-date sort cannot push it past the per-band cap). It also carries SIXTEEN observed series, not five, so the headline card's 'N of 16' caption and its horizontal overflow are measurable instead of vacuous.

SHARED PARTS THIS LANE DOES NOT OWN are verified but NOT asserted here: the list row's date-column absence token, its timeline empty state, its overflow control chrome, its band-block header phrasing, the nav footer and the page disclaimer belong to sibling lanes editing the same base. Adding expectations for them here would make this spec red for work another lane is landing.

children.name: rail card 4 is Legend, mounted after NEXT DATA DROPS
region 7a, NEXT DATA DROPS row 1, a single-digit date keeps the artboard's exact 70px track
children.note: FOLD 60, and the reason this row is geometric rather than a bounds check. The date cell is `white-space: nowrap` in what was a HARD 70px track; 'Thu Sep 10' measures 75.7px, and every box up to the card is `overflow: visible`, so the date did not clip, its glyphs PAINTED 6px into the producer-name column beside it. A boundsCheck was written first and REFUTED BY ATTACK: restoring the hard 70px left it MATCH, because a bounds check compares element RECTS and the span's rect stays 70px while its text paints outside it. Text overflow is invisible to rect geometry. What does catch it is the resolved track list. The track is `minmax(70px, auto)`: row 1's single-digit date ('Sat Sep 5') still resolves to EXACTLY the artboard's 70px, and only row 2's two-digit date grows, by the 5.7px it actually needs, with the name column at `minmax(0, 1fr)` yielding them. Reverting to `70px 1fr` turns this row MISMATCH (measured 70px 186px).

forbid.name: D-M4: no list row carries more than one absence token
forbid.reason: D-M4 (operator mobile report 2026-09-08) [CONFIRMED at 1440 and at 390]. The impact, due and tier cells each rendered their own <Absence>, so a row missing all three drew a dashed baseline plus UNSCORED plus PENDING plus NOT IN PRIMARY SOURCE — three tokens, the third on a line of its own. Ruling 2.1 allows exactly ONE reason per row. This selector matches a row carrying a token in TWO of the three cells, which is the defect and nothing else. The structural guarantee is ListRow's `reasonSlot`.

forbid.name: no sparkline anywhere in the HEADLINE SERIES card
forbid.reason: Artboard 04/id="p4" draws no sparkline in this card, measured: zero <svg> elements in the whole card. The build drew one per series.

forbid.name: no 1m or YoY delta row in the HEADLINE SERIES card
forbid.reason: p4's card carries ONE delta, inline with the value. The build stacked Δ1w, Δ1m and ΔYoY on rows of their own beneath it, which is what made the card 119px tall against p4's 86.84px.

forbid.name: no 'N more headline series below' disclosure
forbid.reason: p4 shows five and captions the head '10 of 16'; the remainder scrolls sideways in the same row and the rest is the Series board the head links to. A vertical 'more below' disclosure is not in the artboard.

forbid.name: no 'Counts are live for the current selection' caption under the rail FILTERS card on /market
forbid.reason: Verified by rendering artboard 04 (id="p4") itself in chromium and reading the FILTERS card's text: it draws NO caption. FOLD 63 (2026-09-08) rewrote this reason: lane market63 made the caption a per-surface `filtersFootnote` prop that /market passed `null`, and lane communitynav2, folded in the same train, removed the sentence and the prop SITEWIDE on the operator ruling of 2026-09-08 ("gone everywhere ... Remove from /regulations too; the artboard is corrected"). The forbid stands unchanged and is now true of every list surface, not of /market alone; the mechanism is that FiltersRailCard has no caption to render.

forbid.name: CLASS CLOSURE (market list): a card element that renders no 3px rule
forbid.reason: Coordinator note N3: 'Prove the class is closed ... a check that fails when a card element renders without it'. Encoded as a FORBID, which is the harness's own form for 'the design does not have this element': every card in the product is `SectionCard` (src/components/ui/SectionCard.tsx), which stamps `data-section-card` on itself and mounts the 3px rule in one of exactly two positions (its first flow child, or inside its own absolutely positioned wrapper when the card carries padding). This selector reaches a card with the rule in NEITHER position, so a match is a ruleless card and the row goes NOT IN SPEC. Ruling 5.2's band-grouping card, the one card that legitimately draws no dark-grey rule, stamps `data-section-card="band-grouping"` instead, so it is outside this selector by identity rather than by being invisible to it.
